thread:
Alex Chen: Quick check — who is on the 15:00 deploy window for model-svc? Need a smoke owner and someone ready to run rollback if we see perf regressions. PR: https://git.redwood/model-svc/pull/482 :eyes:

Maria Gonzales: I can take smoke ownership for this one. planning to run the small prompt set and traces.

Samir Patel: I'm the deploy owner. ETA 14:50 to start canary, full rollout by ~15:10 if green.

Jia Li: Can confirm rollback plan is ready. Steps in runbook: `infra/runbooks/model-svc-rollback.md`. TL;DR: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-svc --to-revision=3` then invalidate cache.

Alex Chen: Awesome. Maria — can you run these quick checks after canary succeeds:
- sanity prompts (login, generate small reply)
- latency check <200ms p95 on canary
- KV cache warm validation

Maria Gonzales: Got it. I'll paste results here. Also will monitor token throughput and any 5xx spikes.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Samir for 2025-11-12 15:00 UTC. Canary group: 5% traffic. Auto-fallback enabled.

Samir Patel: Canary started. logs: `deploy --image model-svc:v2.4.1 --canary=5%`

Maria Gonzales: Canary smoke — prompts OK, sample outputs look good. Latency p95 = 185ms, errors 0/250 requests. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: Great. Samir, if rollout reaches 30% without issues, we can continue. If any anomaly, trigger rollback and notify infra.

Samir Patel: Rolling to 30% now. Ping me if you see anything weird.

Jia Li: Observability hooks active. I'll watch traces and increase sampling for the next 30m. Also prepped the hotfix branch if we need to patch.

Maria Gonzales: 30% OK. Latency stable, minor tail increase on one pod (cpu spike), restarting that pod now.

Samir Patel: Pod restart complete, continuing rollout to 100%.

Alex Chen: Reminder: DM me when done so we can update the release tracker. Also leave a short note in the PR about post-rollout perf numbers.

Samir Patel: Done — rollout 100% finished at 15:18 UTC. No rollback needed.

Maria Gonzales: Post-rollout quick checks: p95 190ms, no 5xx, KV hits steady. Leaving watch for 30m then clear.

Jia Li: I'll keep tracing on for 1h and tag any regressions. If anything questionable, I'll post here with links to traces.

Alex Chen: Thanks team — closing the window. Please add final status in the release doc and mark the PR merged. :white_check_mark:
